Also "敲诈勒索罪" (extortion) if demanding money by threatening to continue lock. Also "诈骗罪" (fraud) if deception to obtain money. Here they lock devices (by unauthorized access) and then demand payment to unlock. This is akin to "非法获取计算机信息系统数据、非法控制计算机信息系统罪" (Article 286 of Criminal Law) maybe. Also "敲诈勒索罪" (Article 274). The typical charge for ransomware-like behavior is "非法获取计算机信息系统数据、非法控制计算机信息系统罪" (illegal intrusion) plus "敲诈勒索罪". However Chinese law also has "破坏计算机信息系统罪". But they didn't destroy data, just locked. The act of remote lock via Apple ID is unauthorized control of computer information system. So "非法获取计算机信息系统数据、非法控制计算机信息系统罪". Also they extorted money: "敲诈勒索罪". Also "非法获取计算机信息系统数据、非法控制计算机信息系统罪" requires that the act is for profit, which is true.
